articleTitle: Analysis of the measurement plane change in street illumination measurements
abstract: Street lighting is an important element of the infrastructure influencing road safety. An important role is the proper design of street lighting as well as verification of lighting levels in the process of operating the luminaires. For complex road situations, where luminance measurement is not possible, the standard allows for the use of class C and intensity measurement. Measurements of the intensity of street lighting involve the use of a hand-held luxmeter, which makes the measurements time-consuming and labor-intensive. An alternative are measuring systems located on the roof of the vehicle, while there are currently no standards for the use of dynamic measurements in normative tests. The article presents an analysis of the use of the inverse square method to interpolate measurement planes and the Dialux environment. The results confirmed the validity of the use of the method and were used to validate the measurement results obtained using our own dynamic street lighting intensity measurement system.

articleTitle: ISO standard implementation impact in COVID-19 erra on UV-lighting devices
abstract: The process of providing the safety of medical devices is very important in our days. Standards in the field are one of the most common and reliable criteria for assessment of the quality of such equipment. At the moment in the situation of COVID-19 the results during the process and after it are very important. Many manufacturers sell UV lamps in order to kill viruses and bacteria. The situation is almost the same with face masks.The proposed paper presents a survey and an approach for implementation of criteria in order to prove the safety of medical devices.

articleTitle: Influence of the Constructive and Environmental Parameters on the Thermal Conditions of a LED Driver
abstract: The design of LED drivers is especially important for ensuring their temperature regime, and therefore for ensuring their reliability and efficiency. This task requires to account for numerous factors. This study investigates the thermal conditions of different LED driver components, using a previously developed model and a specialized software tool, which accounts for 28 parameters of the driver. Several input factors are investigated - the input power, the width of the driver casing, the temperature of the environment and the air velocity. The investigated parameters are the temperatures of the PCB with the SMD components, the non-SMD components, the air within the casing and the casing. The obtained results showed that the components' temperatures have linear dependencies on the input power, the dimensions of the casing and the environmental temperature. On the other hand, the air velocity outside the casing has a nonlinear impact on the LED driver's temperature response.

articleTitle: Photobiological Safety of LED Lighting Systems Applicable in Educational Buildings
abstract: The paper represents a case study of the photobiological safety in educational laboratories with innovated different lighting systems with LED luminaires in the Technical University of Sofia. An assessment of the lighting environment is made for the different design solutions, including human centric lighting. Recommended practice is proposed, based on the measurement results.

articleTitle: Colorimetric Characterizations of Large Area White OLEDs Under Thermal And Electrical Stress Using TM-30-18 Method
abstract: The luminance degradation studies of OLEDs light sources under thermal and electrical stress conditions are normally achieved in order to estimate the OLEDs lifetime. In this study, the colorimetric parameters have been measured and calculated at different durations to understand the behaviour of OLED's spectral distribution power over time. The spectral quantities of the studied OLEDs were measured using a MINOLTA-CS-1000 spectroradiometer, these measurement were treated afterwards in the “ANSI-IES TM-30-18 Basic Calculation Excel Tool”. Results shows that not all the OLED colorimetric parameters know a deterioration in terms of visual comfort when submitted to stress conditions.

articleTitle: Optimization of Energy Consumption of Road Tunnels
abstract: Road tunnels, when regarded as an electric power load, show unique feature - the level of consumption is determined by the level of solar availability. Both events are “in phase” - the higher sun irradiation, the higher the power consumption. That fact makes implementation of photovoltaic generators very efficient and eliminates the need of power storage. Direct power generation is just one of the components that can increase the energy efficiency of road tunnels. The paper discusses a complex of measures causing significant reduction of power consumption and overall expenses of road tunnels.

articleTitle: Study on Factors Correlation of Personal Lighting Comfort Model in Cyber-Physical Human Centric Systems
abstract: Human centric lighting (HCL) is the development trend of future lighting. Human comfort is the result of the combined effects of complex factors, which not only include the illuminance factor of the lighting itself, but also need to consider the temperature, humidity, indoor air speed, and control factors of the environment. Based on the Cyber-Physical Human Centric System (CPHCS), this paper proposes a novel personal comfort model framework based on CPHCS. Analyze the correlation factors of the personal comfort lighting model through the correlation coefficient of the environmental data collected in the smart home, the human heart rate, and the human subjective comfort level data.

articleTitle: Study of the photometric and the colorimetric characteristics of the optical systems of LED domestic lamps
abstract: Study of the photometric and the colorimetric characteristics of the optical systems of LED domestic lamps is done in this paper. The results for the measured maximum luminous intensity, beam angle, distribution of the luminous fluxes in spatial zones and light distribution curves of the bare LEDs lamp and LED lamps with different optical systems are presented. The efficiency losses in the optical systems of the tested LED domestic lamps are shown. A conclusion in terms of the realized photometric indicators and achieved total efficiency of the LED lamp optical system with various diffuser materials is done. Comparative results of measured colorimetric parameters of tested LED lamps as dominant wavelength, color rendering index and correlated color temperature for bare LEDs and LED lamps with optical system are presented.

articleTitle: Improving the Capacity for Adoption of Renewable Energy Sources in Transport and Logistics: Approbation of a Methodological Approach
abstract: The paper, derived from a previously performed by the co-authors empirical study on the topic of attitudes, barriers and options for adoption of renewable energy sources (RES) in their various types (biomass, wind turbines, biofuels, photovoltaics), represents a general methodology concept and its relevant practical approbation for improving the awareness and capacity of regional actors within the triple-helix matrix (business, government, academia) for adoption and application of renewable energy sources (RES) in their activities. In line with one of the topics of the in the EU Strategy for the Danube Region (EUSDR) the methodological approach is practically implemented in drafting a project proposal focused on supporting the effective cooperation of regional actors in Ruse region (Bulgaria), also a cross-border region with Romania. Object of the pilot action is the Intermodal transport and logistics cluster of Ruse (ITLC Ruse) and the empirical results from the approbation are connected with increased knowledge about the motivation for using RES, obstacles, expected results from using RES in business, government and academic organizations; sharing of knowledge, experience and good practices of the stakeholders; elaboration of an integrated policy for better energy efficiency and application of RES in ITLC Ruse, which is set to be practically implemented by a Road map for improving capacity for adoption of RES.

articleTitle: Challenges of Usage of Fuel Cells for LED Lighting
abstract: In the current paper a mathematical modelling of a hybrid system with fuel cell and supercapacitor for usage in LED lighting are realized. Most typical structures for supplying of the system are presented. It is used two different load schedule: for smart home and for street lighting.

articleTitle: Dynamic Color Temperature Sleep Assitant Light Implemented on the Mobile Device
abstract: In this study, we develop dynamic light to improve human sleep quality and apply them to smart mobile devices. This article mainly studies the effects of different spectrum, wavelength and time changes in the light source that adjust the exposure during sleep on the quality of sleep, and then obtains a useful formula for sleep. Since the previous experiment mainly focused on the prototype of the light source, it is not easy to use. Therefore, this research aims to expand the convenience of future use and confirm whether the backplane light source of the smart mobile device can match the results of the previous long-term research. Develop an APP(Application) that uses dynamic sleep light to apply to smart mobile devices. This study mainly uses the dynamic light color temperature and time change of the previous long-term research as the experimental parameter settings, and the results of a small sample trend study found that the effect of the previous experiment is highly correlated with each other, so the number of samples in this experiment is still increasing. The team judges that the future results should be highly consistent with the previous results.

articleTitle: Considerations for measuring the ElectroMagnetic Interference of LEDs projectors with the supply electrical network
abstract: In this paper, the authors present the results of the disturbance measurements transmitted in the power supply network by a YIYI Type LEDs projector. This complex program of disturbance measurements, consisted of measurements of disturbances transmitted by conduction in the frequency range 9 kHz ÷ 30 MHz and radiated disturbances in the frequency range: 9 kHz ÷ 30 MHz, respectively. The penultimate section of the paper presents the interpretation of the measurement results, the levels of disturbances transmitted by the tested LEDs projector and an analysis of the disturbing effects on the power supply network produced by this type of LEDs projectors. In this sense, the test report performed in an existing semi-anechoic chamber (SAC) within the Low and High Voltage Testing.

Author Keywords: radiated disturbances in the frequency ranges required by the standards

articleTitle: Estimation of the Light Pollution, Introduced by the Architectural Lighting of an Educational Building
abstract: The paper aims the estimation of the electrical energy wasted for architectural lighting in different variations of the designed project realized with different light sources. The idea for localized lighting, highlighting the volume of the building of the Faculty of Electrical Engineering of the Technical University of Sofia is made by means of LED strips and LED floodlights with concentrated light distribution. Besides the reduction of the light pollution in the project which uses only floodlights, also the number of the lighting elements is reduced and the artistic idea is kept to a great extent.

articleTitle: Modelling and Optimization of DC/DC Converter for Supplying of LED Lighting
abstract: In this paper a mathematical modeling and optimization of the DC-DC converters are realized. Two different topologies Cuk and Zeta with their particularity are presented. The mathematical model and optimization are realized in MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Self-limiting Tunnel Lighting System, Powered by a Photovoltaic System
abstract: The lighting system of a one-way tunnel serving a junction is considered. Instead of a photometric system for measuring the adaptive luminance L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sub> (in the field of view of the driver of the vehicle) sensorless control of daytime adaptive lighting is provided - L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sub>. It is calculated by the input voltage U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DC_STRING</sub> of the photovoltaic system used to power the tunnel. As the panels are oriented to the south and the tunnel entrance is to the north-west, the relationship between the two quantities is determined by hours of the day, for the 12 months of the year, taking into account the unequal irradiation of the two surfaces.

articleTitle: Tunnel Lighting Control System as a Component of SCADA Cloud Technology for Road Section
abstract: The surrounding road of Gabrovo is an infrastructure project. Part of it is the tunnel under the Bakoyski Bair at the 12th kilometer of road III-5004. The tunnel has a pipe with two lanes, two leading strips and sidewalks. It is equipped with the safety systems required by norms - lighting, ventilation, signaling systems, fire alarm and video surveillance. The report examines the features of the control system for power supply and lighting, as well as the functions of a local SCADA system to the safety systems. The format of the data to the SCADA system of the road section, designed as a cloud service, is given.

articleTitle: Architectural Lighting Development when Financial Restrictions Apply
abstract: The paper is dedicated to economic analysis of the possible design decisions for the architectural lighting of the building of the Faculty of Electrical Engineering of the TU of Sofia. Such an analysis is necessary because of the financial limitations set for the design and installation costs of the lighting system. Because of the great variety of LED products available on the market today replacement of lighting equipment is possible with minor change of the artistic idea, but with great difference in the amount of the initial investment.

articleTitle: Research of Effectiveness on LED Dimming Lighting Installations
abstract: There was made research of lighting installation on characterized administrative room. For lighting of the room there was used LED panels, controlled by dimmable electronic module. The total installed power of the installation is 210 W. There was made research on electricity consumption of luminaries depend to obtaining lighting flux. The resulting dependence is nonlinear function. Mathematical model is derived describing consumption on electricity power as a function of receiving light flow, when the installation was in dimming regime.

articleTitle: In-Vehicle Lighting and its Application in Automated Vehicles: A Survey
abstract: During the last decade, hundreds of articles have been published on human factors in Autonomous Vehicles (AV). This survey presents a summary of published articles on the interior Lighting environment of Autonomous Vehicles. We mainly focus on the in-vehicle lighting and its application in Autonomous Vehicles like Taking over Request (TORs) for Distracted driving (NDRT) in Autonomous Vehicles, visualisation of speed, and perception towards cabin lighting. This literature survey aims to shorten the gap by providing a comprehensive survey of critical studies and a broad range of knowledge for an excellent start-up.

articleTitle: Light Emitting Diode Modules with Reflective Optical System that Implements the “Flat Beam” Lighting Technology
abstract: The article presents a method for implementing the “Flat Beam” lighting technology for an LED module made according to the chip on board technology using several reflective surfaces.

articleTitle: Weaving with Light
abstract: This paper reports on the first stage of research on how to integrate lit fiber optics with a woven textile structure to create fully integrated lighting surfaces. The application of such surfaces aims to produce a wide distribution of low constant illuminance levels for lighting urban environments.

articleTitle: Dual-band CPW Transparent Bandpass Filter for Wireless Communication
abstract: In this study, we present a new transparent flexible coplanar waveguide (CPW) bandpass filter using polyethylene terephthalate (PET) substrate while the simulation results permit to characterize the filter in terms of bandwidth, S-parameters, and current distribution. The resonator of the filter is implemented using a special compact square ring resonator patterned in the central conductor of a CPW transmission line. The impedance bandwidth of the proposed bandpass filter in the lower and higher frequency bands are 5.4% (10.3 to 10.87 GHz) and 11.2% (12.7 to 14.2 GHz) respectively, making this transparent filter suitable for dual-band X and Ku bands applications. Due to its foldable, bendable and transparent qualities, this filter can easily be integrated together with an OLED light source.

articleTitle: Comparison Between Optimal Methods for Control of DC/DC Converter for Supplying of LED Lighting
abstract: In the current paper a comparison between several control strategies for LED lighting application are presented. A classical method such as control with PI regulator is described. Also, several methods such as linearization, model predictive control and neural network are realized. The basic idea in this study is to find optimal solution suitable in multiple cases for control of DC-DC converters supplying LED lighting.

articleTitle: Smart Grid-based Conceptual Model of Virtual Infrastructures for Developing Innovation Capability of Danube macroregion
abstract: The paper presents a brand-new strategic approach for planning the development of virtual research scientific infrastructures (RIs) at transnational level. The creativity of the proposed conceptual model lays down in the specific integration of 4 (four) different already known innovation-based frameworks: (1) smart grid framework for energy efficiency; 2) smart city framework for regional development; 3) sustainable development framework; and 4) security and safety framework in one hybrid intelligent strategic model, which is aiming to ensure the advanced regional development and territorial cohesion using the innovations and knowledge as driving-forces for positive change within larger scope e.g. Danube macroregional area.

articleTitle: Electroencephalographic Study of Human Brain: Chromatic Light Impact on Biological Rhythms
abstract: Growing evidence suggests that blue light has a specific effect on human brain activity. Lighting companies are already actively promoting human-centric lighting. Here, the impact of chromatic light on the human brain was studied. The effects of blue, green, and red light on brain activity were compared using electroencephalography. Differences in brain activity in the occipital and central zones were analyzed. Two gender groups participated in the experiment. The frequency distribution of electroencephalographic signals for the central zone is significantly different in two gender groups. Photostimulation by chromatic light-emitting diodes initiates relatively the same signals in the occipital area. The frequency distribution of electroencephalographic signals in the central zone had a greater excitation of brain activity in blue photostimulation compared to green and red ones. This feature is noted in two gender groups. Blue light has an exciting effect on brain areas responsible for human biorhythms.

articleTitle: UVC Irradiators for Sterilization of Recirculated Air in Workrooms
abstract: The report discusses an energy efficient method and devices to improve the efficiency of ventilation systems in workplaces. By adding UVC-irradiators the pathogenic microorganisms in the recirculated air are destroyed with minimal addition of fresh air. In combination with recuperators, the efficiency of ventilation systems is significantly increased.

articleTitle: A Study of Lightings for Elder with Dementia
abstract: I This study sought to obtain empirical evidence for the impact of through the auxiliary healthy light, delaying disease Senile Dementia and change periodicity of the disease. Through the research, we designed 10 groups of healthy light sources to find out the best parameter formula. The data were elicited using physiological measurement (including sleep actigraphs monitoring at night, body temperature and Oral Fluid Test. Eight subjects (4 males and 4 females) used a quasi-experimental which had been design to assess the effects of were used as indicators to explore the non-subjective assessment of lighting sources on the index, and The center for experimental studies expression scale (CES-D) was used as the subjective assessment of the subjects. The results of this study showed that sleep actigraphs users among Efficiency, Latency and the Number of Awakenings had been attained the best formulation performance at 5000k/6000lx. Besides, (CES-D) is displayed in the oral fluid test high illumination and high correlated color temperature(CCT) even better performance.

articleTitle: Modeling of Hybrid Systems with Renewable Energy Sources for Smart Home
abstract: In this research a mathematical model of a hybrid system with wind generator and supercapacitor for supplying a smart home is realized. The model is described with the aid of differential equations. The simulation and numerical results are presented. The model is developed in MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Sketch drawing on infinite paper sheets
abstract: The process of drawing theoretically infinite drawings on infinite paper sheets is normal for many industries. Ordinary today used techniques exploited for relatively short drawings (size A0 or similar) are useless for this problem. The proposed paper presents a solution of a flatbed plotter for drawing long (theoretically infinite) drawings. The problems with paper shifting and rotation as well paper corrugation are solved using specific optical sensor and the appropriate software.

articleTitle: New CIE Standard Illuminant L and its Affect on Measurement Uncertainty
abstract: The aim of the research was to find out how proposed new CIE standard illuminant L would influence the measurement uncertainty of photometrical field measurements of luminance and illuminance. With help of data of 10 different photometers and 75 spectral power distributions (SPDs) of light sources a large number of spectral mismatch correction factors (SMCFs) were calculated and analyzed. Based on preliminary results, 10 different light sources were selected as possible calibration sources. For each SPD of considered light sources most suitable calibration source was found together with overall best calibration source which gives SMCFs closest to value 1 for all photometers and light sources. Results show that white LED with CCT close to 4000 K is the best suitable calibration source and its use would in average decrease the measurement uncertainty of field measurements of luminance or illuminance by up to 2 %. The decrease can be noticed at average as well as at very good instruments.

Author Keywords: calibration of illuminance and luminance meters

articleTitle: Rehabilitation and modernization of outdoor lighting systems in settlements
abstract: The paper presents solutions related to replacement of conventional luminaires with energy-efficient LED luminaires, rehabilitation of power supply switchboards aiming remote control, as well as the introduction of a photovoltaic plant for the needs of street lighting - electricity generated during the day is sold to the grid and at night buys energy for outdoor lighting. This decreases three times the annual lighting costs of the municipality.

articleTitle: Sources of Long-Term Economic Growth and High Technologies in Telecommunications
abstract: The main issue that arises from the many years of telecommunications history is that outdated regulatory frameworks designed to defend consumers from monopolistic practices tend to actually defend monopolistic market structures from entrepreneurs that wish to introduce new business models, services and technology. The goal of the paper is to discuss the role of investment into telecommunications technology on economic growth and the necessary conditions for its effective application. It presents the causal links between the climate for entrepreneurship and innovation, with particular reference to the contemporary role played by telecommunications technology in Bulgaria. The role of telecommunications technology in the modern economy and its connection to total factor productivity, as well as the barriers to the effective application of that technology, are investigated. Some of these barriers are intrinsic to the technology itself, but many are the consequence of government regulatory and legislative policies that limit entrepreneurial undertakings.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Modeling and Comparative Photometric Analysis of LED Lamp with Polycarbonate, Polymethyl Methacrylate and Acrylic Diffuser Materials
abstract: Building and study of a three-dimensional model of an optical system of LED lamp for indoor lighting and photometric analysis by using Monte Carlo raytracing method of the modelled optical system with a diffuser made of various transmissive materials, transmittance and scattering angle is done in this paper. The results for the calculated number of ray reaction, zonal luminous fluxes, beam angle, light distribution curves and efficiency of the LED lamp optical system for different materials of the modeled diffuser are presented. A conclusion in terms of the realized photometric indicators and achieved total efficiency of the LED lamp optical system with various diffuser materials is done.

articleTitle: Test-based approach to selecting a new PACS
abstract: For a period of 10-15 years (2005 - 2018), the number of PACS systems offered on the market has increased more than 10 times. Each new PACS offers an extension of the existing possibilities by adding various “new” or “useful” functions or by changing the operating characteristics of the system (transfer speed, processing speed, the size of processed images, the volume of the archive, etc.). Despite this growing up, some of the main disadvantages of this class of systems persist: the systems are complex and expensive to acquire, replace, maintain, or repair. This paper aims to show an approach that allows us to choose the right PACS for the needs of a particular group of hospitals and health care institutions.

articleTitle: Calibration of a Brightness Matching Experiment setup in Mesopic and Scotopic Conditions
abstract: The system under calibration has been previously characterized in photopic conditions. Due to increased interests in mesopic conditions, it was adapted to be usable in such an environment. Preliminary tests raised concerns about the stability of the generated stimulus. This paper retraces the steps which were consequently applied to fully capture, analyze and comprehend the source of observed stimulus instabilities. Through statistical analysis of the numerical results, some hypotheses were dismissed. The purpose of this paper is to expose a rigorous methodology in order to establish a well-controlled experimental environment.
